text: Gas Line Tie-in Work The supply and return gas line shall have a tie-in process with the existing BF gas line. The supply gas line shall enter the project area through identified pipe corridor, and the return gas line shall use the same pipe corridor up to the tie-in point. The tie-in process shall follow sequential activities for safe implementation. There will be a set of actions to be done before and for the readiness of the BF gas flow shut-off phase. During the shut-off phase of BF gas flow, a group of sequential activities must be done to complete the tie- in process. Erection of items must be done with the help of a mobile crane. A tentative scheme for the tie- in process has been mentioned herewith. 2.1.1 Activities During BF Gas Pre-Shut-off i. Fabricate two numbers of T joint pieces –one side to be fitted with a Goggle valve (supply/return line) and another with a companion flange of the Goggle valve (main line).
